# DogsBay DITA tutorial — Reference

## Reference

- [Element index](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-dita-tutorial-docs/reference/element-index.md): Every DITA element and attribute in the tutorial, with the stage that introduces it, from stage 00 to stage 25.
- [The gate](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-dita-tutorial-docs/reference/the-gate.md): Reference for scripts/check-stage.sh, the check every stage passes; its steps, switches, environment variables, exit codes, and why not xmllint.
- [Branches](https://dogsbay.ai/dogsbay-xml-dita-tutorial-docs/reference/branches.md): The stage branches, how to compare any two of them, and how to reset your clone to a stage.
